# Proximity IED
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Press \[F\] to plant and arm it: it primes after 5 seconds, then any player who comes within 6 m sets it off.*

| Property | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Size | 2 |
| Category | Explosive |
| Hit points | 1 |
| Charge | Small |
